summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 providing an ATM program update and bitcoin holdings update. For the week ending June 14, 2026, the company sold 1,732,553 shares of Class A common stock for net proceeds of $209.0 million, with $25.7 billion remaining available for issuance. No preferred stock was sold during the period. Separately, it reported acquiring 1,587 BTC for $100.0 million at an average price of $63,024, bringing total holdings to 846,842 BTC. These are routine periodic updates with no special-situation event—no merger, tender, spin-off, restructuring, or activist campaign is announced. The filing merely reports ongoing sales and bitcoin purchases, which are ordinary operational updates for this filer.
